in_sanskrit.name: अजिताभ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ajitaabh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ajita' meaning invincible, unconquered, and 'abh' meaning father. This name signifies a strong and powerful father who cannot be defeated.

in_hindi.name: अजिताभ
in_hindi.meaning: अजित (ajita) - अजित हुआ (ajita hua) - अभ (abh) - वादेरा (vadera)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ajitaabh in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ajita' and 'abh'. 'Ajita' means invincible, unconquered, and 'abh' means father. This name is also translated as 'ajit vadera', which means invincible father or unconquered father.

in_tamil.name: அஜிதாப்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Ajitabh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ajitam' and 'ap'. 'Ajitam' means invincible, unconquered and 'ap' means father. This name signifies a powerful and invincible father.

in_telugu.name: అజితాభ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Ajitabh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ajitadesam' and 'abh'. 'Ajitadesam' means invincible, unconquered and 'abh' means father. This name signifies a powerful and invincible father.

in_marathi.name: Ajitaabh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajitaabh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajitaabh is a compound name derived from Ajita and Bh. Ajita means 'unconquerable, invincible, unyielding, and unvanquished'. Bh means 'lord'. Hence, Ajitaabh can be interpreted as 'The Unconquerable Lord'.

Ajita means 'unconquerable, invincible, unyielding, and unvanquished'. Bh means 'lord'. Hence, Ajitaabh can be interpreted as 'The Unconquerable Lord'.
